title: AMOLED terminal onboarding configuration
description: Documentation contract for values accepted by the on-device captive portal. The firmware stores these values in NVS; it does not load this JSON file.

password.description: Blank only for an open network; otherwise 8-64 bytes.

bridge_url.description: Full read-only feed URL. HTTPS is accepted; HTTP is restricted in firmware to private, local, or tailnet hosts. Embedded credentials, fragments, whitespace, and redirects are rejected.

bridge_bearer_token.description: Revocable per-device token issued by the local bridge. Never use an exchange API key.

device_id.description: UUIDv4 generated by the device and persisted in NVS. It is not configurable by the consumer.
